title: 冬の日常の場面
lead: こたつ・雪かき・結露・マフラーなど、冬の暮らしの場面12点です。ブログ・スライド・社内報の挿絵に使えます。
subject_en: Winter everyday-life situations with ONE person (adult, short dark hair, simple clothes, dot eyes), each a small complete scene with a few props, loose hand-drawn style. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
